label: Origin-determined access and worldwise deletion give origin-compatible deletion (inference)
rule: Left-to-right half of origin-determined access applied to the accessible deletion world
meaning: Conditional entailment, the converse of originDeletion: under the only-if (essentialist) half of origin-determined access, an accessible world lacking x keeps the shared individuals' origins near, so worldwise deletion gives origin-compatible deletion. Together the two show that, on the encoded account, worldwise deletion adds exactly a claim about which worlds exist; origin essentialism constrains it only through individuals other than the deleted one.
